headline: Daniel Ek backs AI researcher's fusion power startup
pages: Spotify founder Daniel Ek is backing Europa Fusion, a stealthy UK startup founded in February by AI researcher Nantas Nardelli, TechCrunch reports. Bloomberg first reported Ek's involvement. Nardelli previously worked at Google DeepMind, Facebook AI Research and Microsoft Research Cambridge, and most recently led machine learning at Pacific Fusion, which recently broke ground on a demonstration facility in New Mexico. A source said Nardelli disagreed with the heavy focus on hardware and favors a more simulation- and data-heavy approach. Europa will still pursue pulsed-power fusion, which uses timed surges of electrical current to compress fuel until atoms fuse.

No one has yet built a fusion plant that supplies electricity to the grid. If the technology becomes commercially viable, it could be a major carbon-free power source drawing on nearly limitless fuel. Source: TechCrunch.
